messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: network-egress-high-packetloss (eu-west-1) -> severity P1. Runbook: network-egress-degradation. Please acknowledge.

sara-net: ack. grabbing BGP/if counters + traceroutes. tagging #oncall.

leo-sre: saw a spike in retransmits from eu-west-1 app tier 03 ~5m ago. Is this a provider-wide issue?

sara-net: initial check: packet loss outbound to TransitX ASN 64512 -> 25% across multiple /24s. Other upstreams (ProviderZ) not showing loss.

priya-eng: customers reporting elevated API latencies and DNS resolution failures for eu-west-1 regional endpoints. This is causing cross-region jobs to timeout. Filing impact now.

anne-support: CS: two paying customers (enterprise) on-call. sending interim note: "We're investigating network egress anomalies impacting connectivity to TransitX. Traffic being mitigated; expect partial recovery."

sara-net: bgp neighbor summary dump: ```
Neighbor        AS    PfxRcd  Up/Down
198.51.100.1    64512  310     00:03:22
203.0.113.2     64499  298     14d
```

sara-net: ifstats (egress eth2): TX drops 22.4%, TX errs 0. traceroute to 198.51.100.1 shows loss starting at provider egress.

leo-sre: could be a TransitX PE fabric problem or an accidental route dampening causing intermittent blackholing. Any sign of withdraws?

sara-net: yes, seeing frequent intermittent withdrawals for specific more-specifics. Looks like they are flapping routes back into our RIB.

matt-oncall: runbook step: attempt traffic steering to ProviderZ for affected prefixes as temporary mitigation. Prepends + community-tagged to avoid pulling in unintended paths. Be mindful of session churn.

sara-net: applying route steer now (throttle 20s): ```netops apply route-policy steer-away-transitx --prefixes 198.51.100.0/24,198.51.101.0/24 --target ProviderZ --prepends 4 --community 64500:9000```

incident-bot: Action logged: route policy 'steer-away-transitx' applied by sara-net at 2026-03-15T08:14:37Z.

leo-sre: after steer, packet loss to customers dropped to ~2% but DNS resolution latency still elevated for eu-west-1 due to cached failures. TTLs are short; should clear soon.

transitx-support-bot: Ticket TX-55231 opened with TransitX NOC. NOC initial: "We see egress drops from PE cluster affecting a subset of peers. Investigating hardware/queueing. Next update in 10m."

priya-eng: customers: ~9 accounts affected, replication jobs lagging and some short-lived 5xx spikes. CS posted a timeline and mitigation note.

anne-support: sending 1:1 updates to enterprise contacts. asking if we can provide a technical summary once provider confirms root cause.

leo-sre: watching for route oscillation — ProviderZ accepts the prepends but we're seeing moderate update churn in the RIB. I recommend holding steering for 30m and monitor.

sara-net: agreed. rolling window set. also verifying NAT session preservation after path change. sample flows show NAT state intact. reconnects minimal.

transitx-support-bot: NOC update: "Hardware issue isolated to a PE leaf cluster; failover initiated. Some peers may see intermittent withdrawals during convergence. We will provide further status when traffic stabilizes."

matt-oncall: note for post-incident: quantify impacted p99 latency and bytes retransmitted, list of affected prefixes + customers, and exact route-policy commands used. Owner: leo-sre.

priya-eng: readying customer follow-up templates with timings and what we did. will include rollback criteria and ETA.

incident-bot: automated metric check: egress packetloss eu-west-1 -> TransitX now 1.7% (alert cleared).

anne-support: CS: updating customers that mitigation is in place and we're monitoring.

sara-net: preparing provider session logs and RIB dumps for postmortem. saving timestamps and commands used.

transitx-support-bot: NOC update: "Traffic restored post-failover, replacing faulty PSUs on the affected PEs. We will confirm stability after 60 minutes."

leo-sre: leaving handoff for night: matt-oncall, summary: mitigation via steering to ProviderZ; ticket TX-55231; monitor DNS cache clear and replication recovery; rollback only after TransitX confirms 60m stability. Postmortem owner: leo-sre.

matt-oncall: ack, taking handoff. escalation criteria: packetloss >5% or provider reintroduces flapping routes.

priya-eng: CS to follow up with enterprise contacts in 1 hour with final status.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: SEV1 -> ticket INC-2026-99102. Closing active paging after handoff.

matt-oncall: locking thread. ping me in #oncall with any regressions. :lock:
